Laurey 87904, T-Knob Melrose in Satin Brass

The Satin Brass Melrose T-Knob matches the Melrose Satin Brass Cabinet Bar Pull for a complete, modern kitchen remodel. The Melrose Satin Brass 2 Inch Pull has a sleek design and a beautiful finish color. This kitchen cabinet pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 87904 Melrose Satin Brass T-Knob:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Satin Brass
  • Length: 2"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.
